description: Cs₄NaHf₃H₂F₁₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are four inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.24 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.21 Å. In the third Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve F atoms. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.04-3.60 Å. In the fourth Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.43 Å. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.42 Å. There are three inequivalent Hf sites. In the first Hf site, Hf is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Hf-F bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.26 Å. In the second Hf site, Hf is bonded to seven F atoms to form HfF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one HfF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are a spread of Hf-F bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.15 Å. In the third Hf site, Hf is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted corner-sharing HfF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are four shorter (2.03 Å) and three longer (2.14 Å) Hf-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two F atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.37 Å) H-F bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two F atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.37 Å) H-F bond length. There are fourteen inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Cs and one Hf atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Cs and two Hf atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cs, one Hf, and one H atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cs, one Hf, and one H atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Cs, one Na, and one Hf atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one H atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Cs and two Hf atoms. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one H atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Cs, one Na, and one Hf atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Cs and one Hf atom. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Cs and two Hf atoms. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two Hf atoms. In the thirteenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Cs and one Hf atom. In the fourteenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Cs and one Hf atom.
